## Jet Cab AMS MCP Server

The official remote MCP server of Jet Cab AMS, a private chauffeur service in Amsterdam. Agents can list fixed-price Schiphol routes, private tours and vehicles with prices (list_services), get an exact signed price quote for a ride (get_quote), and send a booking request (request_booking). Booking requests are confirmed by the customer by email before the business sees them; nothing is charged through MCP. No authentication is needed.
